newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak 1yr state bond ave yield rises to 15.868pct.
newsitem.headline: Slovak 1yr state bond ave yield rises to 15.868pct.

text.p: Average yield at an auction of one-year Slovak state bonds on Tuesday rose to 15.868 percent, from 14.88 percent in the last successful auction of similar bonds on March 25, the central bank (NBS) said.

The NBS added in a statement that the Finance Ministry accepted bids worth 10.1 billion crowns, out of an overall total of 11.3 billion crowns in bids. The ministry rejected all bids in its last auction of one-year state bonds on April 22.
The bonds carry a fixed annual coupon of 10.00 percent.

The ministry uses its treasury bills and state bonds as its main tools to cover the budget deficit, which totalled 3.45 billion crowns in the first quarter of 1997, up from 361 million in the first two months of this year.
